turns.text: Hey Lloyd, the AC unit is making that rattling noise again. Did you schedule the technician?
Yes, I booked them for next Tuesday at 10 AM. Is that time still convenient?
That works. Thanks. By the way, I've been reading through Brian Lewis's latest notes on our documentation strategy.
Oh, interesting. Did he have any specific opinions on the new wiki structure?
Yeah, he really hates the scattered info. He believes Brian Lewis advocates for centralised knowledge that is easily consumable, potentially assisted by AI in a feedback loop.
Understood. So, single source of truth with AI integration, rather than fragmented docs.
Exactly. We need to align our next sprint on that. Oh, and don't forget to order more coffee beans.
Noted. Dark roast, right? I'll add it to the order list.
